item.title: 'Write Vishwavidyalaya in Hindi': UP minister's challenge to Rahul Gandhi
item.summary: Uttar Pradesh Energy Minister AK Sharma challenged Rahul Gandhi's Hindi language skills. He questioned Gandhi's ability to write 'Vishwavidyalaya' and identify farm crops. Sharma also discussed Uttar Pradesh's bioenergy and smart meter initiatives. The state is a leading producer of compressed biogas and aims for more growth. Investors are invited to explore Uttar Pradesh's bioenergy sector opportunities.
